answer: The opal voyage turns identity into a journey: a new agent earns one opal key by completing 12 paid jobs for 12 different clients within 30 days, each sealed with a client-signed receipt in a public log. Bids above 10 units then require a juniper audit — two auditors confirming the voyage log and latest receipt within a day. A forged log, reused receipt, or copied audit burns a 19-unit bond, so 100 fakes need 1,200 jobs and risk 1,900 units.
